changes: Introduces the polished four-tab Client experience for Dashboard, Requests, Latest Changes, and Settings.
Adds responsive shared status, compact request entry, structured publish filtering, and safe lazy album artwork while preserving older summary-only history.
Adds in-app support email and synchronizes completed Publisher request statuses back to Client history.

builds.label: v1.4 production release
notes: Preserves Client and Syncthing identity, request history, selected library, and update configuration during upgrade.
Uses stable request IDs for idempotent Completed status and Last Update synchronization.
Keeps the established Dropbox update URL and backward-compatible profile/changelog schemas.

changes: Connects automatically when the request email exactly matches Jeff's invitation email.
Waits for and accepts the expected Syncthing library offer, then configures Receive Only and starts synchronization.
Provides neutral timeout guidance with Try Again, Edit Email, and Cancel when the Publisher has not completed the connection yet.

builds.label: RC4 remote changelog refresh
notes: Refreshes the visible Updates changelog from the existing GitHub release feed after startup and manual update checks.
Uses the bundled changelog when the remote feed is unavailable or malformed, without creating a changelog cache.
Keeps update checks off the Client UI thread and reuses the existing changelog request.

builds.label: RC4 automatic invitation onboarding
notes: Replaces manual Publisher approval with automatic invitation-email matching during Gmail refresh.
Keeps KMM Client open while it detects and configures the Syncthing offer automatically.
Preserves the existing Dropbox installer URL and self-update download path.

builds.label: RC4 email credentials embed fix
notes: Embeds KMM Client email credentials in the packaged client so connection requests and client preference emails can be sent from fresh installs.
Keeps the distribution install test changes and client polish features intact.

builds.label: RC4 distribution install test
notes: Fresh full-install test build for wiped-PC validation before distribution.
Includes dashboard library browsing/search, wildcard search, default audio app launch, clearer sync status, rolling Latest Changes, email preference behavior, and filename old -> new change details.
Keeps the confirmed onboarding, approval refresh, Syncthing configuration, email preference, and Update Now behavior.

builds.label: RC4 client polish preview
notes: Adds the dashboard music library browser with in-app folder navigation.
Adds library search with Windows-style wildcard support such as *.mp3.
Double-clicking a track opens it in the user's default audio app.
Improves Dashboard, Sync Status, and Latest Changes wording for client clarity.
Adds last successful sync reporting and clearer 100% complete sync status.
Cleans older corrupted change-note characters in Latest Changes.

builds.label: RC4 final
notes: Final RC4 client build after live validation of onboarding, approval refresh, client update/restart, dashboard size, email opt-out, and Latest Changes history.

builds.label: RC4 update handoff test marker
notes: Minor no-behavior-change build for testing the KMM Client Update Now install and restart flow.

builds.label: RC4 silent Explorer update restart fix
notes: Runs in-app updates silently with the update flag so the installer does not launch KMM itself.
Waits longer after installation and relaunches KMM through Windows Explorer to avoid PyInstaller Python DLL startup errors.

builds.label: RC4 email credentials and checkbox style fix
notes: Embeds KMM Client email credentials in the packaged build so email preference updates can notify Jeff.
Keeps the published update email checkbox background steady on mouseover.

builds.label: RC4 CMD update handoff fix
notes: Replaces the hidden PowerShell update handoff with a Windows command-file handoff so Update Now can reliably start the installer after KMM closes.
The handoff waits for the installer to finish, then reopens KMM Client automatically.

builds.label: RC4 publish email opt-out
notes: Adds a Client Settings option to opt in or out of published library update emails.
Publisher imports client email preferences and excludes opted-out users from publish notification emails.

builds.label: RC4 rolling latest changes
notes: Latest Changes now displays a rolling chronological publish history instead of only the most recent publish.
Publisher writes publish_history into the synced client profile while keeping the existing latest-publish fields for compatibility.

builds.label: RC4 dashboard size authority fix
notes: Makes the packaged installer profile authoritative for the client dashboard library size.
Prevents stale synced client_profile.json files from older Dropbox Music tests from overwriting the dashboard size.

builds.label: RC4 manual launch with updater suppression
notes: Manual installer runs launch KMM Client after setup, as expected for first-time users.
In-app updates pass an updater flag so the installer does not launch KMM while the client-controlled restart handoff is active.

builds.label: RC4 client-controlled update restart
notes: Closes KMM Client before starting the downloaded updater, then relaunches KMM after the installer exits.
Removes installer-side auto-launch to avoid PyInstaller Python DLL startup errors caused by overlapping restart paths.

builds.label: RC4 installer relaunch handoff fix
notes: Uses a delayed detached relaunch after client updates to avoid PyInstaller Python DLL startup errors.
Preserves startup-only and button-click update checks.

builds.label: RC4 client profile priority fix
notes: Ensures the client dashboard uses the current packaged library profile instead of stale cached Dropbox Music data.
Keeps the synced library profile as the final source when a newer profile is delivered through the shared folder.

builds.label: RC4 delayed relaunch fix
notes: Delays KMM Client relaunch until after setup exits to avoid PyInstaller Python DLL startup errors.
Keeps automatic restart after update without launching the app while the installer is still closing.

builds.label: RC4 installed build label fix
notes: Shows the exact installed client build label and build ID instead of only 1.4 RC4.
Makes the current-build confirmation specific enough for hotfix testing.

builds.label: RC4 direct Update Now flow
notes: Changes the Updates button to Update Now whenever a newer build is available.
Starts download and installation directly instead of showing a separate confirmation notes popup.

builds.label: RC4 changelog history fix
notes: Updates the Client changelog display to show the RC4 build history in chronological detail.
Shows individual hotfix/test build notes before the broader release baseline.

builds.label: RC4 update auto-restart fix
notes: Relaunches KMM Client automatically after the installer finishes an update.
Keeps the installer handoff flow where KMM Client closes before updating.

builds.label: RC4 installer handoff fix
notes: Starts the downloaded installer directly instead of covering it with a follow-up popup.
Closes KMM Client after launching the installer so the update can replace the app cleanly.

builds.label: RC4 update indicator fix
notes: Replaces flashing update text with a steady Update available status.
Fixes the extra error popup when closing or declining the update prompt.

builds.label: RC4 repair-tab hidden test build
notes: Temporarily hides the unfinished Repair tab while repair tools are redesigned.
Keeps the stable Dropbox changelog feed for client update testing.

builds.label: RC4 final candidate
notes: Adds the Updates tab indicator for newer hotfix/beta/final-candidate builds.
Uses the shared Dropbox changelog as the remote update feed.
Includes the confirmed one-click Refresh Approval Status timing fix.
Includes final RC4 onboarding and Syncthing Receive Only confirmation fixes.

builds.label: RC4 hotfix build
notes: Refresh Approval Status waits briefly for Syncthing to present the Publisher folder offer so approval can complete in one click.
Syncthing install now shows progress while downloading and installing.
Onboarding storage free-space display refreshes after browsing to a different drive.
Onboarding uses the current test-library profile size when packaged by Publisher.

changes: Removed the obsolete Open Download Page action.
Consolidated the Updates tab to a single Check for Updates action.
Fixed Check for Updates hanging while checking the Dropbox installer.
Added client-side approval status refresh based on the Syncthing library share.
Improved shared-folder detection and pending Syncthing offer messaging.
Added refreshable Latest Changes support from the synced Publisher client profile.
Fixed update checks failing with missing version-parser support.
Kept direct update download and install workflow.
Aligned client version reporting with Publisher RC3.
Added a permanent Updates tab to KMM Client.
Added bundled client changelog display.
Added stable Dropbox update download.
Added download progress and SHA-256 calculation.
Added one-click launch of the downloaded installer.
Preserves completed onboarding and local request history during updates.
Added Publisher Gmail inbox and Messages Center.
Added bug report and feature request categories.
Corrected selected client tab sizing.
Added client Syncthing Sync Status and performance reporting.
Added permanent client dashboard after onboarding.
Added direct client email communication.
Added client requests and local request history.
